title: Sept. 1 Powerball: $1.2 Billion Jackpot Winner?
text:
Powerball Jackpot Climbs to $1.3 Billion as Mega Millions Hope Builds Meta Description: The Powerball jackpot hits $1.3 billion after no winner on Sept. 1, 2025. Discover your odds, how to buy lottery tickets , and more.
The Powerball jackpot has escalated to an estimated $1.30 billion, following Monday’s drawing on Sept. 1, 2025, which saw no grand prize winner. With a cash value projected at $589.0 million before taxes, this historic sum now ranks as the fifth-largest in Powerball history, fueling widespread anticipation for the next drawing.
While the allure of a billion-dollar prize is undeniable, the odds of winning the Powerball jackpot or a Mega Millions grand prize remain exceptionally long, standing at approximately 1-in-292 million. This staggering figure means countless everyday events are statistically far more likely to occur than landing the top lottery prize.
Monday’s Drawing: Million-Dollar Payouts,No Grand Prize Despite no one claiming the massive top prize,Monday’s drawing on Sept. 1, 2025, still produced notable winners. is straightforward, though the path to the jackpot is anything but.A standard ticket costs $2 and can be purchased at numerous retail locations, including convenience stores, gas stations, and grocery stores. Online purchases are also an option in select states.
Players must select six numbers: five white balls from a pool of 1 to 69, and one red Powerball from 1 to 26. For an additional $1, players can opt for the Power Play feature, which multiplies non-jackpot winnings by 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, or even 10X. Those who prefer a computer-generated selection can choose the Quick Pick option. To win the coveted powerball jackpot , players must precisely match all five white balls in any order and the single red powerball. Lottery odds explained
